lesson.title: 4.6 Getting ready for school day routine
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
lesson.sub_lesson_title: Getting ready for school day routine
lesson.goal: Describe getting ready for school in order with first, then, after that and finally.
lesson.grammar_function: Describe getting ready for school in order with first, then, after that and finally.
lesson.prerequisite: Familiar Unit 1 people/actions, Unit 2 objects/park, Unit 3 speakers/possessions and Unit 4 home/morning language.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Describe getting ready for school in order with first, then, after that and finally.

models.text: After that, I brush my teeth.

cards.pedagogy_note:
The same boy sits up in bed, awake, in morning light.
Introduce FIRST at the beginning of this morning. Indicate the first scene in the six-photo strip.

The boy washes his face at the bathroom sink, still in pajamas.
Introduce THEN through wake up → wash face. Indicate the two consecutive moments.

The boy is fully covered and buttons his blue school shirt in the bedroom.
Introduce AFTER THAT through wash face → get dressed. Indicate the move to the next action.

Now dressed for school, the boy eats breakfast at the kitchen table.
Continue the same morning with THEN. Connect getting dressed to eating breakfast.

options.label: After that, I brush my teeth.

cards.pedagogy_note:
The dressed boy brushes his teeth at the bathroom sink.
Continue the same morning with AFTER THAT. Connect breakfast to brushing teeth.

cards.spanish_translation: Por último, voy a la escuela.
cards.pedagogy_note:
The boy carries his green bag and walks through the school entrance.
Introduce FINALLY and GO TO SCHOOL at the end of this getting-ready routine. Indicate the last scene in the complete strip.
